## Result

- Skill: proposal-review
- Review status: approved
- Vision alignment: aligned
- Material findings: none new from Proposal Review.
- Open blockers: no unresolved proposal-level decision; M4 reviewer retains ownership of its existing reliance finding and disposition.
- Proposal readiness: unchanged approved direction remains sufficient on the current living-owner basis below.
- Immediate next stage: isolated stop; M4 reviewer assesses this correction and other downstream assessors retain their duties.
- Automatic downstream handoff: none.
- Claim limitations: current proposal-direction reliance only. This neither verifies complete implementation/source retirement nor establishes final adoption, public release, Design approval, Verify or PR readiness.

## Current reliance and removed originals

R5's current basis included four sources that M4 has now removed: specs/release-process-contract.md, specs/release-transaction-automation.md, docs/adr/ADR-20260523-release-process-contract.md and docs/adr/ADR-20260629-release-transaction-profile.md. Its statement that unchanged source contracts/ADRs remain the current direction basis is no longer usable after removal. This assessment explicitly corrects my own reliance decision rather than treating that wording or a current label as harmless history.

Current reliance on this proposal approval no longer requires any of the six removed originals: those four plus specs/release-process-contract.test.md and specs/release-transaction-automation.test.md. No copy, original-path redirect, archived original, Git reconstruction or historical approval of those files is needed to establish this current direction judgment. References to those original files in the unchanged proposal and prior reviews identify the inspected source group and historical basis; they are not missing current normative owners for this renewed assessment.

The necessary current basis is now the complete proposal under Constitution/Vision; Release's living requirements, representation/runtime relationships, material decisions and source-displacement/consumer map; System's composition/adoption boundaries; Design's DES-SR-21 retention rule; the retained mixed specification's explicit R7/R8 disposition; and current bounded follow-up ownership. Release REL-SR-01–19 and REL-SR-22–24 preserve the direction-level distinctions needed here: routine/exceptional population, preparation versus publication, exact candidate approval, profile authority, required public evidence, safe uncertain retry/recovery, protected publication boundaries and nonblocking diagnostic duration telemetry. Its source-qualified map and REL-DEC decisions preserve the needed transfer and maintenance rationale without consulting deleted prose.

This is a new current assessment, not a retargeting of r5 or an assertion that the old reviews assessed replacement content. R5 and all earlier review bodies, identities, judgments and finding histories remain unchanged and historical; r5 applicability is stale. My proposal judgment does not depend on former source approvals establishing the new model or implementation. Technical transfer completeness remains the Design assessor's responsibility; actual source/consumer outcome remains M4 Code Review's responsibility. Successful final whole-change Code Review and distinct Verify remain necessary for final adoption. This review claims neither that those gates have occurred nor that an unresolved finding elsewhere is closed.

Historical implementation snapshots carried in r5 served the original bounded feasibility inspection, not acceptance proof. They are not current required subjects for this direction-only renewal. The proposal's feasibility continues to be credible from the current Release responsibility/realization and its explicit boundaries; runtime implementation and provider correctness require their own current reviews/proof. Removing those snapshot dependencies does not excuse missing implementation evidence or silently narrow a discovered technical failure.

## Review Dimensions

- Challenge: pass. Fragmented authority and the need for one complete routine operator path remain the unchanged motivating problems. Execution of part of the selected solution does not invalidate its approved direction.
- Goals: pass. One normal approval, automated preparation/checks/publication/observation/reporting, Release ownership and justified source removal all remain visible.
- Scope: pass. Exact candidate authority, bounded telemetry and consumer amendments remain included. Other model transfers and actual external publication retain separate authorization. The six removed originals are the named source group, not a licence for wider deletion.
- Governing principle: pass. Perform and verify the exact authorized operation and expose exceptions while preserving necessary engineering meaning.
- Direction: pass. Current Release requirements express the proposal's candidate identity, applicability, public-safety/retry and truthful evidence distinctions. No new upstream decision is needed merely because the selected original prose files are removed.
- Feasibility: pass. The embedded assessment remains proportionate, explicitly distinguishing existing mechanisms and Design choices from demonstrated conformance. Current owner realization describes candidate preparation, protected execution and public observation. This is a credible direction basis, not a runtime test pass or implementation approval.
- Material impact: pass. Automation, telemetry-policy amendment, irreversible operations, source-removal risks and retained remainders remain disclosed.
- Vision alignment: pass, aligned. Necessary direction, rules and rationale are readable in current owners without reconstructing deleted historical originals. Traceability and explicit human authority remain preserved.
- Downstream authority: pass. Precise contracts, proof allocation, implementation assessment, source deletion evidence and final adoption retain their own independent stages. This review resolves only its own current reliance basis.
- Requested decision: pass. The bounded one-approval Release path/model/source-retirement direction remains unchanged and sufficiently specific.

## Scope Preservation Review

- Scope-preservation result: pass. User goals remain intact: one normal approval, exact candidate binding, automated required work/evidence, safe retry, nonblocking unavailable timing, no duplicated manual entry, coherent Release owner and justified old-source cleanup. Current follow-up ownership retains Distribution/Installation and other independently owned work.
- No historical record, release identity, profile, fixture or schema is treated as disposable prose by this assessment. The reviewed displacement map distinguishes those operational/evidentiary inputs from the selected originals.

## Recommended Proposal Edits

- Recommended edits: none required. Correct the current reliance record, not the unchanged proposal or old judgments.

## Recommendation

- Recommendation: approve continued proposal-direction reliance on this exact current-owner basis. Return this record to the M4 reviewer for its independent finding disposition. It must not be treated as an automatic finding closure or final adoption.
- Checks actually run for this assessment: inspected r5's exact subjects and missing-file status; bounded M4 deletion/name-status diff and current Release requirements/decisions/displacement, System/Design retention and current guidance; primary CLI context/full subject inspect and targeted recording. No historical original was reconstructed as a necessary current rule source. No release, publication or runtime test was executed. Record-store structural validation and diff hygiene follow the save.

## Specialized-gate group

- Active gate predicates: scope_budget_context=true; vision_exception_context=false; standing_artifact_context=false.
- Gate outcomes: scope-budget pass. The current-owner correction preserves selected work and independent follow-ups without extending the initiative.
- Trigger ambiguity: none.

## Durable-recording group

- Recording status: recorded through targeted batch on successful save.
- Recording blocker: none.
- Record path: docs/changes/2026-09-09-release-model-source-consolidation/reviews/proposal-review-r6.json
- Finding-record paths: no new Proposal finding; the existing M4 reviewer-owned finding retains its own record and disposition authority.

## Formal-review group

- Review ID: proposal-review-r6
- Review record: docs/changes/2026-09-09-release-model-source-consolidation/reviews/proposal-review-r6.json
- Governed change identity: 2026-09-09-release-model-source-consolidation
- Invocation classification: formal-lifecycle/manual; PRR1G-recorded-context-gated.
- Independence: original independent Proposal assessor authored no reviewed engineering or proposal. This new judgment corrects only that assessor's current reliance; no proposal, engineering, other review finding or activity/work routing is edited.
independence_basis: Original independent Proposal assessor authored neither proposal nor engineering. Independently reassessed current direction reliance after mapped source removal, replacing reliance on originals with necessary current owner content without retargeting historic judgments.
